resources.string: See what you say while you say it.
Shows the Ciao button while the keyboard is open, and types what you dictate into the text field. Ciao only looks at which field has focus and its text, and never sends it anywhere.
Needs access to gpt-live-transcribe. Live dictation costs $0.017 per minute of speech; idle time is free. The key stays on this phone.
Recording starts only when you tap the Ciao button and stops when you finish.
Turn on “Ciao dictation” in Accessibility. Ciao uses it to see when the keyboard is open and to type the text into the field.
Switch greyed out? Android blocks this for apps installed from a file: open App info, tap ⋮ in the corner, choose “Allow restricted settings”, then come back.
Tap the field below, then tap the Ciao button above the keyboard and speak. Tap it again or say “ciao ciao” to finish. Hold it to talk while held. Drag it to move it.
Sign in to use the same terms, context and API key on all your devices. They\'re kept in a hidden Ciao folder in your Google Drive; Ciao can\'t see any other file there.

Easier: on a new device you just sign in, no key to paste. The keys sit in the hidden Ciao folder in your Google Drive, so anyone who can sign in to your Google account can read them. Turn this off to keep each key on its own device only: Ciao removes them from Drive.
Google no longer gives Ciao access. Sign in again
The sync file was written by a newer Ciao. Update the app
no access to Drive. Sign in again and tick the box about configuration data in your Google Drive
What you usually talk about. Helps the recognizer with names and terms.
